limitations: Exact file hashes detect byte-identical frames only.
Decoded-pixel hashes detect identical RGB buffers after decoding, not near duplicates.
The 9x8 grayscale dHash at Hamming distance <= 6 is method-limited; absence of reported pairs is not proof that no near-duplicate exists.
No model-based perceptual duplicate check was performed.

fingerprint.recipe: regular files under data/ (no symlinks), sorted by POSIX relative path; for each: UTF-8 path + NUL + raw 32-byte SHA-256 of content; no trailing NUL/newline; lowercase hex

instance_semantic.definition: union(instance values 1..N) == semantic value 2, per instance frame

limitations.statement: The historical fingerprint recipe is a local reconstruction; matching it does not prove the original Stage 2 implementation byte layout.
Visual registration of frames, semantic masks and instance annotations was not assessed in the MVP.
Exact, decoded-pixel and dHash checks are method-limited; no reported pair is not proof that no near-duplicate exists.
Source groups are attribution-derived groups, not scene identities, split units or source rankings.
No local release, version or checksum identifier verifies upstream provenance.
Missing per-image licence tokens remain unresolved and are not evidence that an image is unlicensed.
